title: Mayday
description:
S11 E02 — The Plane That Flew Too High
West Caribbean Airways Flight 708 crashes down killing 160 people in 2005, ultimately leading to the bankruptcy of the troubled airline.

title: Mayday
description:
S11 E03 — Split Decision
Arrow Air Flight 1285 with 248 American soldiers on board crashes seconds after refueling in Newfoundland.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S10 E03 — Break Up Over Texas
Near the end of its flight, Continental Express Flight 2574 suffers wing damage and goes into a dive falling out of the sky.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E05 — Mayday Munich
A plane with members of the Manchester United football team crashes while heading home from Yugoslavia, killing 23 aboard.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E06 — Turning Point
A Northwest Airlines flight cruises above the Bering Sea before problems develop and pilots must make an emergency landing in Anchorage.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E07 — Bad Attitude
Korean Air Cargo Flight 8509 crashes shortly after take off from London Stansted Airport on December 22, 1999.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S10 E08 — Hiding in Plane Sight
In 1978, PSA Flight 182 collides with a Cessna and crashes into a San Diego residential area killing people on both planes and seven people on the ground.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E09 — Under Pressure
On July 11, 1991, the crew of Nigeria Airways Flight 2120 unsuccessfully tries to return to the airport after a burst tire creates an in-flight fire which causes 247 Nigerian pilgrims and 14 crew to perish.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E10 — I'm the Problem
Moments before Pacific Southwest Flight 1771 crashes on a cattle ranch in California, gunshots are heard in the cabin.

title: Mayday
description:
S11 E11 — Nowhere to Land
Pilots of TACA Flight 110 make a remarkable landing on a narrow levee, but investigators must find out why the engines in a brand-new plane failed.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E12 — The Invisible Plane
SAS Flight 686 takes off from Milan's Linate Airport and moments later collides with a Cessna on the runway.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S11 E13 — Impossible Landing
A shocking look at the fate of United Airlines Flight 232 which crashed into Sioux City's runway in 1989 causing a subsequent explosion that left 111 people dead.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E01 — Hanging by a Thread
Aloha Airlines Flight 243 loses part of its roof of the front fuselage before landing safely at Kahului, Maui.

title: Mayday
description:
S03 E02 — Attack Over Baghdad
The crew of DHL Flight OO-LL must land the plane using only the engines to control the craft when a left wing explodes causing the plane to lose hydraulic pressure.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E03 — Out of Control
JAL Flight 123's steering system stops working 12 minutes after takeoff, causing the plane to crash into the side of a mountain and kill 520 people in 1985.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E04 — Suicide Attack
A FedEx flight out of Memphis descended into chaos when a surprise attack by a disgruntled employee threatened the lives of all on board.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E05 — Bomb on Board
On December 11, 1994, a terrorist bomb explodes on Philippine Airlines Flight 434, yet only one passenger dies.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E06 — Mistaken Identity
A high-tech American gunship stationed in the Persian Gulf shoots down Iran Air Flight 655 carrying 290 people when its systems confuse it with an Iranian fighter.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E07 — Helicopter Down
In 1995, a chopper carrying 18 people to a North Sea oil platform crashes; miraculously, everyone onboard survived in a life raft.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E08 — Death and Denial
EgyptAir Flight 990 suddenly crashed into the sea, killing all 217 people aboard and causing controversy over whether it was intentional or a mechanical malfunction.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E09 — Kid in the Cockpit
A Russian pilot allowed his teenage son to take control of Aeroflot Flight 593, setting in motion a chain of events that caused the deaths of 70 people.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S03 E10 — Impact on the Rails
With its conductors sound asleep, a freight train fails to stop and collides with an oncoming train, resulting in tragedy.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E11 — Express Samina
A Greek ferry, the Express Samina, is pushed off course by strong waves and crashes into a rock formation causing eighty passengers to lose their lives in the freezing water as they wait for rescue.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S03 E12 — Unstoppable Train
A freight train carrying an excess of cargo loses its brakes while descending a mountain causing it to gain speed and derail into a neighborhood killing several people.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S03 E13 — African Hijack
When three hijackers ordered an Ethiopian plane to fly to Australia, the pilot tricked them by flying south along the African coast, with deadly consequences.

title: Mayday
description:
S04 E01 — Desperate Escape
In August 2005, Air France Flight 358 skidded off the runway in Toronto, trapping more than 300 passengers on the plane.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S04 E02 — All Engines Failed
British Airways Flight 9 falls toward the ocean when all four engines mysteriously fail, and then restart.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S04 E03 — Fiery Landing
When fire erupted aboard Air Canada Flight 797, the pilot made an emergency landing; flames engulfed the plane when the doors opened, killing half of the passengers.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S04 E04 — Missed Approach
Korean Airlines Flight 801 overshoots a runway during the final approach for a night landing and crashes into a hillside on Aug. 6, 1997.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S04 E05 — Mystery Crashes
Mystery surrounds two 737 crashes until USAir Flight 427's near miss gives investigators the information to solve the case.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S04 E06 — Panic Over the Pacific
A stalled engine causes China Airlines Flight 006 to go into a deadly spin before crew members were able to regain control.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S04 E07 — Out of Sight
A 1986 midair crash between Aeroméxico Flight 498 and Piper Archer N4891F near Los Angeles results in the creation of a collision-avoidance system.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S04 E10 — Inbound
U.S. Secretary of Commerce Ron Brown and 34 others are killed in 1996 when their Air Force 737 crashes on a mountain in Croatia.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S04 E09 — Deadly Disorientation
Flash Airlines Flight 604 crashes into the Red Sea shortly after take-off, killing all 148 people on board.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S04 E06 — Unconscious Pilot
The worst crash in Greek aviation history occurs in 2005 when all 121 people on board Helios Airways Flight 522 lose consciousness.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S05 E01 — Invisible Killer
During a storm, a strong gale slams Delta Airlines Flight 191 to the ground killing most people on board.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S05 E03 — Miracle Flight
A pilot heads for a decommissioned air force base, not knowing it is hosting a weekend family event, when the passenger jet he is flying unexpectedly runs out of fuel.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas
description:
S05 E06 — Southern Storm (Southern Airways Flight 242)
The pilots of Southern Airways Flight 242 must try to land on a Georgia highway after the engines die and the windshield shatters.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S05 E07 — Explosive Evidence
A bomb explodes on Air India Flight 182 en route from Canada to India causing it to disintegrate over the coast of Ireland.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S05 E10 — Miami Mystery
Pilots of Eastern Airline Flight 401 try to determine why both landing-gear lights do not function, tragically distracting them.

The tragic circumstances surrounding the bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 by terrorists.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S07 E07 — Silent Killer
In September 1989, Partnair Flight 394 crashed into the sea killing all 55 people on board.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
Collision Course
Saudi Airways and Kazakhstan Airlines jets hit each other at 14,000 feet sending both planes spiraling to the ground.

title: Mayday: Air Disaster
description:
S07 E05 — Operation Babylift (C-5 Galaxy 68-0218 )
During the Vietnam War when over 250 children, who were being airlifted to safety on a US Air Force C5A Galaxy, died in an explosion.

title: Mayday
description:
S07 E06 — Falling Fast
Investigators discover a shocking mistake when pilots must ditch their plane in the Mediterranean, killing 14 of the 34 passengers.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:
S07 E05 — Deep Freeze
A design flaw sends American Eagle Flight 41-84 smashing into a cornfield outside of Chicago, killing all 68 people on board.

An Air Inter flight crashes into the Vosges Mountains while attempting to land killing most of the 96 passengers.

title: Mayday: Catástrofes Aéreas
description:

Chalk's Ocean Airways flight 101 crashes just after take-off from Watson Island in Miami on December 19, 2005, killing 20 people.

description:

British Airways' flight number 38 suffers from double engine failure and crashes near Heathrow in 2008.

Two minutes after Scandinavian Airlines Flight 751 left Stockholm in 1991, smoke filtered through the cabin and both engines failed, one erupting into flames.
